title: The Eensy Weensy Spider | Kids Songs and Nursery Rhymes | Super Simple Songs
speaker: Super Simple Songs - Kids Songs
zh: 【Super Simple Songs - Kids Songs】Eensy Weensy 蜘蛛 |兒歌與童謠 |超簡單的歌曲（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: The eensy weensy spider went up the water spout
cues.en: The eensy weensy spider went up the water spout
cues.zh: 這隻小小的蜘蛛爬上了噴水嘴

cues.text: Down came the rain and washed the spider out
cues.en: Down came the rain and washed the spider out

cues.text: Out came the sun and dried up all the rain
cues.en: Out came the sun and dried up all the rain
cues.zh: 太陽出來了，把所有的雨水都曬乾了

cues.text: Then the eensy weensy spider went up the spout again
cues.en: Then the eensy weensy spider went up the spout again
cues.zh: 然後那隻小小的蜘蛛又爬上了壺嘴

cues.text: Okay…put your fingers together Let's do The Eensy Weensy Spider
